name: Chain of Thought Podcast Archive
tagline: Search and cite what AI practitioners said on the Chain of Thought podcast
description: Read-only search over the Chain of Thought podcast's transcripts and episodes: interviews with engineers, founders and operators shipping AI in production. Four tools: search transcripts, search episodes, get an episode, and get a transcript excerpt. Every result links to the episode page so the agent can cite it. No login or API key.
